resources.string: This settings screen is unavailable on this firmware. Open app details manually.
Xiaomi family detected. Available settings depend on your ROM and region.
This device is not identified as Xiaomi, Redmi or POCO. Standard Android settings remain available.
Allow Hyper Essentials to start automatically after a reboot.
Android battery optimization is disabled. MIUI may still apply its own limits.
Choose No restrictions in battery settings if background tools stop.
Review background pop-ups and lock screen permissions. Enable only what your selected tools require.
Choose which notifications and service channels to allow.
Required only for overlay features. Grant access when you use them.
Required only for tools that use accessibility. Review the service description before enabling.

Some features require Shizuku or root. Pixel-only functions are not guaranteed on MIUI or HyperOS. OEM settings may be hidden or renamed; app details opens as a fallback. This port has not yet been verified on physical Xiaomi devices.

Start the Shizuku service first and allow Hyper Essentials in its authorized apps. Notification access is separately required for music players. MIUI may restrict shell operations; a connected binder does not guarantee every system permission.
Volume down · hold 2 seconds → screen off
Requires the Hyper Essentials accessibility service. Short presses still change volume. Camera shortcuts take precedence. Disabling restores the previous binding.
